title: AAJ IMAAM-E- RAZA SHAHEED HUWE
body:
aaj imaam-e- raza shaheed huwe
shaah-e- har dosaraa shaheed huwe
seh ke ranj-o- balaa shaheed huwe
khaake zehre daghaa shaheed huwe
<<MINI>>
shaah ke sab ghulaam rote hai
ham se ruqsat imaam hote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tha jo maamoon rasheed baaniye shar
dushman-e- qaandaan-e- paighambar
tha jo aamaadah zeher dene par
shaah ko phir talab kiya aaqar
<<MINI>>
sun ke shaah-e- anaam ghar se chale
hoke ruqsat imaam ghar se chale
<<DIVIDER>>
jab nazar aayi qabr-e- paighambar
hilgaya seene me dil-e- muztar
jaake lipte lahad se phir sarwar aur kiya ye qitaab roro kar
ek lehza na chain paaya hoo'n
ruqsat e aaqri ko aaya hoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke ruqsat huwe imaam-e- raza
tha madine me tahalka barpa
koi qadmo'n se lipta jaata tha aur labo'n par kisi ke thi ye sadaa
aye shah-e- ausiyaa qudaa haafiz
aye imaam-e- raza qudaa haafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
tay manaazil ko karke phir ek baar
aaye darbaar me shah-e- abraar
uthaa taazeem-e- sheh ko wo makkaar
paas apne bithaa liya zinhaar
<<MINI>>
tab kaha shaah se ye wo maghroor
aap is waqt khaaiye angoor
<<DIVIDER>>
jabr se us laee'n ke waawailaa
khaa ke angoor ko uthe moulaa
poocha mamoon ne chale kis jaa
kaha hazrat ne tu jahaa'n bhejaa
<<MINI>>
keh ke ye shaah e qaas-o- aam chale
sar pa daale abaa imaam chale
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar me aakar tadap rahe the imaam
zaher ne kar chuka tha apna kaam
qai jo aayi liyaa jigar to thaam
tha na ek lehza aap ko aaraam
<<MINI>>
yaas thi bekasi thi ghurbat thi
mere moula pa kya musibat thi
<<DIVIDER>>
muztarib the bohat shahe zeejaah
ghash jo taari huwaa imaam pa aah
hichki jo aayi mout ki naagaah phir kahaa laa ilaaha ilaaallah
tan se rooh-e- raza idhar nikli
qabr se faatema udhar nikli
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi'n laashe pe fatima zehra
hai garebaan chaak sar nanga
peet'ti hai ye keh ke sar apna
teri ghurbat pe fatima ho fida
<<MINI>>
bekasi me pada ye laasha hai
koi tujh par na rone wala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj hai us imaam ka maatam
jiska ghurbat me haaye nikla dam
jamma aale aba hai sab baaham
baqar o aur jaffer o kazim
<<MINI>>
jisne dukh zindagi me paaye hai
uski mayyat pe rone aaye hai
